en: Vintage sepia-toned view of a small town in a mountain valley beside a river. In the foreground is a metal truss bridge crossing the river. Behind it stands a compact cluster of buildings dominated by a tall church tower and a large church-like structure. Rugged mountains rise steeply in the background. The caption in red at the upper right reads "Ala (Trentino); Pilcante", and there is part of a postage stamp visible at the top edge.
